capabilities.title: Extract code structure and cross-file relationships locally with tree-sitter across many languages
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README What it does and pyproject.toml tree-sitter dependency inventory
capabilities.reason: Nexus has repo-intel and codegraph lanes but has not yet proved Graphify-equivalent multi-language AST extraction.

capabilities.title: Combine code, documents, SQL schemas, office files, images, audio, and video in one graph
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README overview, optional extras, and supported input sections
capabilities.reason: The company-map tranche records this as optional repo intelligence and does not add new file or media ingestion.

capabilities.title: Label every graph relationship as extracted or inferred
capabilities.reason: The company map preserves the distinction in analysis, but Nexus does not yet generate or validate Graphify-compatible edge provenance.

capabilities.title: Detect communities and highly connected concepts without requiring an LLM
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README God nodes and Communities capability rows
capabilities.reason: Existing Nexus graphs are separate product features and have not been validated as Graphify-equivalent code community analysis.

capabilities.title: Query the saved graph, explain a concept, and trace paths between concepts
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README query, explain, and path command examples
capabilities.reason: A protected fixed-command adapter and acceptance proof would be required before Nexus can expose these operations.

capabilities.title: Write graph.json, GRAPH_REPORT.md, and interactive graph.html artifacts
capabilities.reason: Nexus has not selected an ignore, retention, privacy, or VAULT filing policy for generated Graphify artifacts.

capabilities.title: Install host-specific assistant skills for Codex and many other coding tools
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README Install and supported platform table
capabilities.reason: Nexus labels the available Codex path but intentionally does not run or reproduce Graphify's external installers in this tranche.

capabilities.title: Install hooks or instruction files that direct assistants to query the graph before broad source searches
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README Make your assistant always use the graph
capabilities.reason: Nexus will not let an optional external tool rewrite project instructions or hooks without an explicit reviewed adoption task.

capabilities.title: Expose graph queries through an optional MCP server
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README optional mcp extra and pyproject.toml graphify-mcp entry point
capabilities.reason: An MCP integration needs explicit installation, authentication, size limits, and protected runtime proof.

capabilities.title: Push graph data to optional Neo4j or FalkorDB backends
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README optional extras and pyproject.toml exporter dependencies
capabilities.reason: The current Nexus slice is local-first and does not need a second graph database service for the department map.

capabilities.title: Use Ollama, OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock, or Azure backends for semantic passes
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README backend extras and pyproject.toml optional dependencies
capabilities.reason: Any future semantic pass must go through Nexus provider policy instead of Graphify calling providers independently.
